Name: (AT) Old-Timey Cottagecore Furniture
Author: 8BitAlien
Description:
Cosy cottagecore furniture set for Alternative Textures framework. If you want to live out your cottagecore dreams, then this is the mod for you!
Includes replacements for:

Artist Bookcase - Chest of Drawers, Old-Times Bookcase
Bamboo Mat -  Shaggy Brown Rug
Bed - Cottage Bed
Brick Fireplace - Cottage Fireplace
Brown Armchair - Comfy Cushioned Armchair
Brown Couch - Comfy Cushioned Couch
Coffee Table - Grandma's Coffee Table
Dark Rug - Fluffy Cocoa Rug
Double Bed - Deluxe Cottage Bed
Futan Bear - Ol' Reliable Bear
Large Futan Bear - Large Ol' Reliable Bear
Modern Lamp - Grandma's Lamp
Needlepoint Flower - Bonsai Painting
Oak End Table - Grandma's End Table
Old World Rug - Grandma's Rug

Also adds 2 new flooring types and 4 new wallpapers!
